summary: NextPlat Corp via its indirect subsidiary Progressive Care, LLC entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Scott's Pharmacy, LLC for $1.5M in cash, subject to post-closing inventory adjustment. The $50K initial deposit is credited at closing; an additional $50K held in escrow for indemnification. Closing targeted by September 30, 2026, extendable to October 31, 2026. The agreement includes customary representations, a 30-day due diligence period, and a three-year non-compete covering Escambia County, FL. Watch for regulatory approvals and lease negotiation completion.
